title: How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs
dek: Two costs that show up after the box is open.
status: Published as a working draft. No named editor (FLG-R12).

body.text: Cleanup and counter space are often decided after purchase. Two of the titles we read name dishwasher-safe parts: {{P-01}} lists 'Dishwasher Safe Frying Baskets', and {{P-03}} lists a 'Dishwasher-Safe Basket'. The title of {{P-02}} does not mention cleaning, so check its product information.

items: Which parts does the listing say are dishwasher-safe? Which parts are not mentioned?
How much counter space is needed in use, including the lid or door swing? Check the listing dimensions and the manufacturer's manual.
Where will the appliance be stored when not in use?
Is there a drip tray or crumb tray? How is it removed and cleaned?

body.text: We did not test cleaning and did not measure space. Dishwasher suitability is shown only by the wording of the listing titles.
